title: [DEV] AAPS/AAPSClient NSV3-tab getting alot of spam and stops sync (V3+WS API)
symptom: AAPS/AAPSClient 3.2.0-dev-l build f717d7a0b2-2023.09.16: after enacting TT from AAPSClient around 15:55, there is a lot of spam in both AAPS/AAPSClient NSV3-tab, and as a consequence sync is not working. At 16:05 spam is still there in both tabs.
cause: The issue is resolved by a pull request in nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor (#8100), indicating the root cause was in the Nightscout server's V3 API handling.
fix: The fix is provided by nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor pull request #8100, which resolves the issue. A workaround is to disable v3 API and enable v1 API, then after sync is fixed, v3 API can be used again.
